V. 62.
On the morrow, the day that followed the day of the preparation—The Day of Preparation was the Day before the Sabbath, whereon they were to prepare for the Celebration of it. The next Day then was the Sabbath according to the Jews. But the Evangeliſt ſeems to expreſs it by this Circumlocution, to ſhew the Jeweſt Sabbath was then aboliſhed.
